newsitem.title: CHINA: China listed companies earnings per share up in 96.
newsitem.headline: China listed companies earnings per share up in 96.

text.p: The average earnings per share reported by listed firms on China's two stock exchanges rose to 0.294 yuan in 1996 from 0.265 yuan in 1995, the Shanghai Securities News said on Thursday.
The reporting season for the 595 firms listed on the exchanges in Shanghai and Shenzhen ended on April 30.
All companies met the deadline except for one which only recently listed on the Shanghai exchange and was given permission to delay its annual report for a while, the newspaper said.
The average earnings per share, including newly-listed companies, rose overall by about 10 percent, it said.
Shanghai firms were up only marginally at 0.37 percent, and Shenzhen firms were up 22.5 percent, the newspaper said.
